title: Designer de experiência do usuário
description:
Sobre a WeFit

A WeFit é uma empresa de Digital Service Design. Trabalhamos com grandes empresas consolidadas para transformar desafios complexos em produtos digitais que funcionam de verdade. Não entregamos telas. Entregamos valor.

Nossa filosofia é a resolução de problemas. Se você vem do design gráfico, de comunicação visual ou de outra área criativa e quer migrar para UX, essa vaga pode ser para você — desde que tenha fundamentos sólidos e vontade real de aprender.

O que você vai fazer

No início, você vai atuar com apoio da liderança e do time. O que esperamos é que você evolua com consistência, não que já saiba tudo. Na prática, isso inclui:

  • Organizar fluxos de UX com arquitetura de informação e design de interação
  • Montar e manter componentes no Figma seguindo os padrões do Design System do cliente
  • Criar protótipos navegáveis que comuniquem a solução — não só o visual
  • Apoiar entrevistas com usuários e reuniões com clientes
  • Contribuir para a documentação de handoff para o time de desenvolvimento

O que esperamos de você

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Domínio de Figma: você organiza com frames, usa Auto Layout, monta componentes e entende por que grupos não são a melhor opção
  • Conhecimento dos guidelines de UI (Material Design e/ou iOS Human Interface Guidelines)
  • Capacidade de apresentar seu trabalho com clareza — não só o resultado, mas as decisões por trás dele
  • Portfólio com pelo menos um case completo construído do zero, com problema identificado, processo documentado e resultado final em Figma com protótipo navegável. Pode ser de curso ou estudo pessoal, desde que você tenha construído desde o início — não aceitamos projetos baseados em templates prontos ou públicos
  • Pelo menos um exemplo de algo que você criou ou estruturou usando IA — pode ser um fluxo, uma análise, uma estrutura de conteúdo, geração de variações. Não precisa ser uma tela pronta. O que queremos entender é como você já usa IA como ferramenta no seu processo

Seria ótimo se você também tivesse:

  • Familiaridade com Cursor ou ferramentas similares de design assistido
  • Alguma experiência profissional com design de interfaces, mesmo que em contexto diferente de UX

Como é trabalhar aqui

A WeFit já usa IA como copiloto em partes do processo de design — geração de variações de interfaces, apoio a fluxos, análise de pesquisa. Não é tendência aqui, é prática. Por isso buscamos pessoas que já estejam explorando essas ferramentas, mesmo que de forma inicial.

Para posições júnior, lacuna técnica não é eliminatória — falta de iniciativa é. Se você não sabe algo, espera-se que vá atrás. A empresa oferece mentoria, acesso a conteúdo e liberdade para testar. Nossas lideranças são formadas internamente.

Você vai trabalhar diretamente com clientes — sem camadas intermediárias. Isso significa responsabilidade real desde cedo, com suporte de um time experiente por trás.

Processo seletivo

3 etapas: triagem, conversa de fit cultural e entrevista técnica.

Na entrevista técnica você vai precisar trazer duas coisas:

Portfólio no Figma — arquivo aberto com pelo menos um case completo. Queremos ver o problema que você resolveu, como você chegou nas decisões e o resultado final com protótipo navegável. Não aceitamos imagens estáticas nem apresentações sem o arquivo original.

Algo feito com IA — pode ser qualquer coisa que mostre como você já usa IA no processo: um fluxo estruturado com apoio de um modelo de linguagem, variações geradas, análise de pesquisa, estrutura de conteúdo. Não precisa ser uma tela. Precisa mostrar que você já experimentou e tem uma opinião sobre isso.

Modelo de trabalho

Híbrido — presencial no escritório (Av. Faria Lima, São Paulo) ou no cliente algumas vezes por semana.

Setor

  • Desenvolvimento de software

Tipo de emprego

Tempo integral

title: In-House Recruiter
description:
In-House Recruiter

Type: Full-time

Schedule : Monday–Friday

Working Hours: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Pacific Time / 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time

Work Environment: Remote

About the Role

Talent Global is looking for a sharp, fast-moving, and highly proactive In-House Recruiter to help identify, evaluate, and present exceptional talent for our clients.

This role is ideal for someone who can quickly understand different types of positions—from digital marketing and creative roles to sales, operations, and other specialized functions—and translate those requirements into an effective recruiting and interview strategy.

We want someone who thinks quickly, adapts easily, asks the right questions, and takes ownership of finding strong candidates.

Speed matters in this role. The right person will be able to work with urgency while maintaining a high standard for talent selection process, communication, and candidate evaluation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct Interviews: Perform structured Zoom interviews daily to evaluate candidates’ experience, communication skills, technical capabilities, professionalism, and overall fit for roles across Marketing, Design, Sales, Operations, and other functions.
  • Evaluate Candidates: Review applications, resumes, work samples, and portfolios to determine whether candidates meet client expectations. This includes evaluating graphic design and advertising portfolios when relevant.
  • Understand New Roles Quickly: Rapidly learn the responsibilities, terminology, required skills, and performance expectations of unfamiliar positions before beginning candidate evaluation.
  • Maintain a High Talent Bar: Identify strong candidates rather than simply candidates who meet minimum requirements. Exercise sound judgment around experience, communication, problem-solving ability, professionalism, and overall quality.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with account managers and talent sourcers to understand client hiring requirements, priorities, feedback, and changes in recruiting strategy.
  • Present Candidates: Prepare clear, professional, and accurate candidate summaries and evaluations for shortlisted candidates presented to clients.
  • Manage the Talent Pipeline: Build and maintain a strong pool of pre-vetted professionals for recurring client needs and frequently requested positions.
  • Maintain CRM & Documentation: Keep candidate records, interview notes, evaluations, compensation expectations, and recruiting activity accurate and up to date in internal systems.
  • Develop Interviews & Assessments: Create role-specific interview questions, scorecards, assignments, and assessments that accurately measure candidates’ capabilities.
  • Stay Market-Informed: Continuously learn about trends, terminology, tools, compensation, and expectations across digital marketing, creative, sales, and other commonly recruited functions.
  • Contractor Follow-Up: Check in with placed contractors after hiring to support onboarding, identify issues early, and help maintain successful placements.
  • Negotiate Rates: Discuss compensation expectations with candidates and negotiate rates within client budgets while protecting both candidate quality and company margins.
  • Improve Recruiting Operations: Help improve internal recruiting systems, assessment scoring, reporting, data visualization, and workflow efficiency through automation using AI, Make.com, and related tools.
  • Work Independently & Collaboratively: Manage responsibilities independently while maintaining fast, clear communication with talent sourcers, account managers, and the sales team.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

  • Fast-moving: Works with urgency and maintains strong output without needing constant follow-up.
  • Sharp: Quickly identifies important details, inconsistencies, strengths, weaknesses, and potential hiring risks.
  • A fast learner: Can understand a new role, industry, or skill set quickly enough to evaluate candidates intelligently.
  • Accurate: Moves quickly without becoming careless. Candidate evaluations and documentation must be dependable.
  • Highly proactive: Does not wait to be told every next step. Identifies problems, asks questions, follows up, and pushes recruiting processes forward.
  • Adaptable: Comfortable switching between very different roles, priorities, clients, and recruiting situations.
  • Highly selective: Has a strong standard for talent and is willing to reject average candidates rather than lowering the bar to fill a pipeline.
  • Curious: Actively researches unfamiliar terminology, tools, industries, and job functions rather than interviewing candidates with only surface-level knowledge.
  • Decisive: Can form clear candidate opinions and explain the reasoning behind them.
  • Organized: Able to manage multiple interviews, candidates, roles, and follow-ups without losing important details.
  • Clear communicator: Communicates efficiently and professionally with candidates and internal teams.
  • Process-minded: Looks for ways to make recruiting faster, more consistent, and more scalable through better systems and automation.

Success in This Role

A strong recruiter in this position should be able to receive a new job requirement, truly understand what the client actually needs quickly, develop the right evaluation criteria, interview candidates intelligently, and confidently distinguish exceptional candidates from average ones.

The goal is not simply to conduct interviews or move candidates through a pipeline.

The goal is to find strong talent quickly, evaluate them accurately, and maintain a consistently high hiring standard.

title: Account Manager - ISP
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an Account Manager to join our team and lead the development and strategic management of accounts within the Regional Telecom Operator market .

The professional will be responsible for developing business opportunities, expanding existing accounts, building long-term customer relationships, and positioning ZTE as a strategic technology partner for ISPs.

This role will act as a key interface between ZTE, Internet Service Providers, business partners, and internal teams , taking a consultative approach to understanding customers' business challenges and translating their needs into solutions, projects, and commercial opportunities .

We are looking for a professional with a strong understanding of the ISP ecosystem, business acumen, excellent relationship-building skills, and a strong track record in consultative sales and business development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategically manage a portfolio of Regional Telecom Operators , developing long-term relationships and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Develop and execute strategic Account Plans for key customers, aligned with ZTE's business priorities and customers' growth strategies.
  • Continuously map customers' businesses, challenges, investment plans, network expansion strategies, technology roadmaps, and future requirements.
  • Identify cross-selling, up-selling, and portfolio expansion opportunities , positioning ZTE's products and solutions according to customer needs.
  • Take a consultative approach to customer engagement, connecting business challenges with the most appropriate technology solutions .
  • Build strong relationships with executives, business leaders, engineering, technology, procurement, operations, and other key stakeholders .
  • Manage the commercial cycle from opportunity identification through negotiation and closing, ensuring effective pipeline management and achievement of sales targets.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Pre-Sales, Services, Marketing, Product Management, and other internal teams to develop integrated customer strategies and deliver an excellent customer experience.
  • Develop and manage joint business opportunities with distributors, technology partners, and other players within the ISP ecosystem .
  • Monitor sales performance, pipeline, forecast, market share, and account KPIs, using data and market intelligence to drive commercial strategies.
  • Track market trends and developments in the ISP sector, including market consolidation, network expansion, FTTX, Wi-Fi, 5G/FWA, cloud, AI, and new digital services .
  • Anticipate customer needs and position ZTE as a strategic partner for business growth and digital transformation , rather than simply as a technology vendor.
  • Proactively manage customer issues and internal resources to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and long-term account development .

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology or a related field . A postgraduate degree or MBA is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in sales, account management, business development, or a similar role within the Telecommunications and/or Technology industry .
  • Proven experience managing relationships with Regional Telecom Operators, or Telecommunications companies .
  • Strong understanding of the ISP business model and its key challenges related to growth, profitability, network expansion, customer acquisition, and retention.
  • Proven experience in consultative sales, strategic account management, and business development .
  • Strong ability to establish and maintain relationships with decision-makers and key executives .
  • Experience managing partners and developing opportunities through joint-selling and partner-led business models .
  • Strong negotiation, communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
  • Entrepreneurial, strategic, results-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership .
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate commercial data and market intelligence into actionable strategies.
  • Advanced English proficiency .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working for Telecommunications/ICT equipment manufacturers or technology vendors .
  • Knowledge of GPON, DWDM, IP, Infrastructure, cloud, and digital solutions .
  • Experience with ISP network expansion projects or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian ISP market and its key trends and challenges .
  • Experience managing strategic/key accounts and complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations.

The Profile We Are Looking For

More than a salesperson, we are looking for a business leader and strategic partner for ISPs — someone who can deeply understand the customer's business, identify growth opportunities, mobilize the right internal and external resources, and turn relationships into sustainable business results for both the customer and ZTE .

If you understand the ISP market, are passionate about developing new business opportunities, building strategic relationships, and working in a technology-driven and innovative environment, we would like to hear from you.

Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

- Transportation vouchers

- Meals vouchers.

- Health and Dental insurance.

- Life insurance.

- Birthday day off.

- Extended paternity/maternity leave.

- Gympass / Totalpass

Relevant information:

This position is based in the ZTE's São Paulo office (near Berrini avenue), on-site model.

If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE's future, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Location: Brazil (Remote)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. We are currently looking to hire a Finance Manager to join a mid-sized company operating at scale.

About the Role

This is a hands-on finance role with a strong FP&A focus in a flat organization. The position requires a strong individual contributor who is comfortable owning financial analyses and reporting activities end to end.

We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, highly analytical, and action-driven , with the ability to support business decisions through clear and actionable financial insights.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain 3-statement financial models , with a strong understanding of how they flow together
  • Develop financial models and analyses from scratch, including ROI analysis and scenario modeling
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly financial review decks , clearly explaining business performance using financial storytelling, variance analysis, and waterfall analyses
  • Partner with finance leadership and business stakeholders to identify opportunities to improve revenue, margins, costs, and overall P&L performance
  • Support PE-related reporting and ad-hoc financial analyses
  • Help establish and improve FP&A best-practice processes in an evolving environment

Required Experience & Skills

  1. 4+ years of progressive Finance / FP&A experience , with hands-on experience in financial planning, modeling, forecasting, and analysis
  2. Experience within a Big Four firm and/or Fortune 500 company
  3. Experience in mid-sized companies is a strong plus
  4. Strong understanding of 3-statement financial modeling
  5. Advanced Excel skills (heavy modeling role; keyboard-driven workflows preferred)
  6. Experience creating executive-level PowerPoint presentations with clear financial narratives ( IBM Cognos / TM1 experience is a plus, Tableau experience is a plus, but Private Equity experience is highly preferred )
  7. Experience creating and maintaining dashboards, cleaning and validating data, and building data models across multiple data sources. Ability to support cross-database integrations and deliver actionable financial and business insights.

What We’re Looking For

  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, less structured environments
  • Independent and able to take ownership of projects from start to finish
  • Intellectually curious and proactive in asking the right questions
  • Strong bias for action , with a proven ability to challenge the status quo using data

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Your application will only be taken into consideration if your resume is in English!

title: Community Manager (freelancer 3 meses)
description:
Fundada em 2004, a OLIVER é a primeira e única empresa no mundo especializada em criar, construir e operar agências in-house e ecossistemas de marketing sob medida para marcas. Com mais de 300 clientes em 48 países, nosso modelo único impulsiona a criatividade e a eficiência, permitindo a entrega de soluções personalizadas que ressoem profundamente com o consumidor.

Como parte do The Brandtech Group , estamos na vanguarda do uso de tecnologias de IA de ponta para revolucionar a forma como criamos e entregamos resultados. Nossas soluções de IA aumentam a eficiência, estimulam a criatividade e impulsionam a tomada de decisões mais bem informadas, capacitando nossas equipes a produzirem resultados inovadores e impactantes.

Vaga: Community Manager Pleno (temporária - 3 meses)

Modelo de contratação: Freelancer - 14/09 a 18/12

Local: Remoto

A OPORTUNIDADE

Esta é uma oportunidade temporária de integrar o estúdio da OLIVER embarcado com um dos maiores clientes globais do segmento de cuidados pessoais e beleza, como Community Manager Pleno — responsável por manter a comunidade viva, próxima e bem cuidada nos canais sociais da marca. Você será o elo entre a marca e as pessoas que perguntam, comentam, reclamam, elogiam e buscam orientação. Seu trabalho vai além do responding: você transforma interações em relacionamentos reais e conversas em insights acionáveis — contribuindo diretamente para a qualidade do engajamento e para a experiência do público com a marca.

A VAGA

No dia a dia, você é a voz da marca nos momentos que mais importam. Com autonomia dentro das diretrizes estabelecidas, você responde, engaja, monitora e reporta — garantindo presença consistente, tom de voz alinhado e uma experiência humana em cada interação.

Você identifica padrões antes que se tornem problemas, transforma perguntas recorrentes em material útil para o time e apoia campanhas com o conhecimento de quem está mais próximo da comunidade. Este é um papel de entregas independentes, com impacto direto na percepção da marca e na qualidade do relacionamento com o público.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Responding e experiência na comunidade

  • Responder comentários, mensagens e menções com agilidade, clareza, empatia e precisão, em todos os canais sociais da marca.
  • Manter consistência de tom de voz e postura da marca em interações orgânicas e de relacionamento.
  • Orientar usuários sobre dúvidas recorrentes, próximos passos e canais de suporte, com base em FAQs, diretrizes e políticas da marca.
  • Tratar situações sensíveis — reclamações, insatisfações e comentários inadequados — com postura adequada, seguindo os fluxos de escalonamento estabelecidos.

Engajamento e ativação de conversas

  • Estimular conversas de forma natural: fazer perguntas, criar continuidade nas respostas e incentivar participação qualificada da comunidade.
  • Identificar oportunidades de engajamento contextual: trends relevantes, dúvidas comuns, momentos sazonais e campanhas ativas.
  • Priorizar qualidade de engajamento — conversas com significado, não apenas volume de interações.

Monitoramento e escuta social

  • Monitorar diariamente o desempenho do responding: volume de menções e mensagens, tempo e taxa de resposta, temas recorrentes e sinais de risco.
  • Identificar insights de comunidade: necessidades do público, padrões de dúvidas, percepções sobre produtos e temas com potencial de conversa.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Sobre a WeDOTalent

WeDOTalent é uma HRTech brasileira construindo recrutamento autônomo. Aplicamos IA para resolver os problemas reais de quem contrata — operação, viés e escala — sem tirar a decisão de quem entende de gente. Compliance LGPD, EU AI Act e NYC LL144 não são features, são arquitetura.

O que você vai construir

Você vai trabalhar nas camadas centrais do produto — sistemas multi-agente, orquestração de LLMs, pipelines de aprendizado contínuo e infraestrutura de governança. Não é cargo de manutenção. É construção do zero ao escalável, com escolhas que vão definir como o produto se comporta nos próximos anos.

Algumas frentes na mesa:

  • Sistemas multi-agente em produção
  • Orquestração de LLMs e tool calling em escala
  • Avaliação contínua, regressão e harness de teste
  • Infraestrutura de inferência multi-provedor
  • Governança em tempo de execução — fairness, consent, audit e retenção como invariantes do sistema, não checklists

Stack

Python na camada de IA, Ruby on Rails no backend ATS, Next.js + TypeScript no frontend. PostgreSQL com pgvector, Redis, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, GCP.

A stack vai evoluir — o que importa é fluência em sistemas distribuídos com LLM no caminho crítico, não aderência a uma ferramenta específica.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software e em trabalhar com sistemas de IA em produção
  • Profundidade em Python e experiência sólida em LangGraph e AutoGen; familiaridade com LangChain, CrewAI ou outros frameworks de agentes é desejável
  • Experiência construindo sistemas multi-tenant com isolamento real
  • Experiência elevando arquitetura para padrão enterprise — refatorações estruturais, observabilidade, segurança e auditoria
  • Familiaridade com avaliação de sistemas de IA — eval datasets, regression suites, harness de teste
  • Compreende que decisão sobre gente é decisão sensível — discute fairness, viés e compliance como engenharia, não como obrigação

Diferenciais

  • Background em produtos B2B SaaS para áreas regulatadas
  • Contribuições open-source em frameworks de IA
  • Experiência com voice AI, multimodal ou interfaces conversacionais (ElevenLabs, Deepgram, OpenMic AI ou similares)
  • Conhecimento de compliance regulatória (LGPD, GDPR, EU AI Act, NYC LL144)

Como trabalhamos

Time pequeno, decisões rápidas, ambição alta. Cada commit afeta produção. Cada decisão de arquitetura tem peso de anos. Não temos camadas de processo — temos canonical compartilhado e responsabilidade direta.

Localização e modelo

Remoto desde a fundação. Preferência por profissionais baseados em São Paulo para reuniões presenciais pontuais com o time e parceiros. Inglês fluente é necessário para colaboração com fornecedores e literatura técnica.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Vale alimentação
  • Pacote de benefícios flexíveis
  • Pacote wellness (Zenklub e TotalPass)
  • Equipamento de trabalho fornecido
  • Orçamento de aprendizado contínuo (cursos, conferências, livros)
  • Compensação aberta a discussão por experiência

Diversidade e inclusão

Avaliamos candidatos por trabalho técnico e raciocínio — não por marcadores demográficos. Construímos um produto cuja missão é remover viés do recrutamento; aplicamos o mesmo princípio no nosso. Encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas sub-representadas em engenharia de IA.

Etapas de seleção

Processo ágil, em linha com startups em crescimento acelerado: triagem inicial, conversa com fundadores e proposta.

Se preferir, escreva uma nota sobre um sistema de IA que você construiu — o que escolheu, o que descartou, o que aprendeu. Conversamos a partir daí.

title: Paid Search Media Buyer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As a Paid Search Media Buyer at Lilo Social, you will own the strategy, execution, and optimization of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts for our eCommerce clients. You will launch and manage search, shopping, and Performance Max campaigns while conducting ongoing testing to drive scalable growth and meet client ROAS goals. This role requires a data-driven problem-solver who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on campaign management to deliver measurable results for our partner brands.

What success looks like:

  • Consistent improvement in ROAS and conversion rates across your client portfolio through strategic optimization and testing
  • Efficient campaign management that identifies scalable opportunities and maximizes budget performance
  • Strong client relationships built on clear communication, strategic insights, and proactive recommendations
  • Cross-functional collaboration with creative and retention teams that drives integrated marketing performance

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute comprehensive paid search strategies for Google Ads and Microsoft Ads across multiple eCommerce client accounts
  • Manage and optimize search, shopping, and Performance Max campaigns to achieve client ROAS targets and growth objectives
  • Conduct keyword research, expansion, and bid optimization to maximize campaign efficiency and reach
  • Write compelling ad copy for search campaigns and conduct ongoing A/B testing to improve click-through rates and conversion performance
  • Manage product feed optimization for Shopping campaigns in Google Merchant Center, ensuring accurate product data and maximizing visibility
  • Monitor search term reports daily to identify expansion opportunities and refine negative keyword lists for improved targeting
  • Analyze campaign performance data to identify trends, uncover insights, and develop actionable optimization strategies
  • Build and maintain client relationships through regular communication, performance reporting, and strategic recommendations
  • Collaborate with creative teams to develop high-converting landing pages and provide feedback on landing page performance
  • Stay current on platform updates, industry trends, and competitive landscape to maintain cutting-edge campaign strategies
  • Track and report on key performance metrics including ROAS, conversion rates, CPCs, impression share, and overall account health
  • Manage campaign budgets effectively, scaling successful campaigns while maintaining efficiency targets

Requirements

  • 2-4 years of hands-on paid search experience managing Google Ads accounts for eCommerce brands
  • Proven track record of managing significant monthly ad budgets ($50K+) and achieving strong ROAS performance
  • Expert knowledge of Google Ads campaign structures, including Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns
  • Strong proficiency with Google Merchant Center and product feed optimization techniques
  • Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable strategies
  • Excellent proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for data analysis, reporting, and campaign management
  • Strong copywriting skills with experience creating compelling ad copy that drives clicks and conversions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present strategy and results clearly to clients and internal teams

Nice to Have

  • Google Ads certifications (Search, Shopping, Display, Video)
  • Experience with Microsoft Ads (Bing Ads) campaign management
  • Familiarity with feed management tools such as DataFeedWatch, GoDataFeed, or similar platforms
  • Experience with analytics platforms beyond GA4, such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, or other attribution tools
  • Background working in a DTC-focused agency environment managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on US hours
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Vendedor Interno Autopeças - Ferraz de Vasconcelos SP
description:
Sobre a AutoZone

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 167 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.

A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além.   • Realizar atendimentos comerciais via WhatsApp e telefone, prestando suporte ao cliente durante todo o processo de venda;
  • Efetuar o fechamento de vendas com foco em conversão e satisfação do cliente;

  • Gerenciar o caixa da unidade, incluindo abertura, fechamento e controle de valores recebidos;
  • Garantir a correta movimentação financeira, zelando pela segurança e integridade dos recursos;
  • Registrar informações de vendas e atendimentos em sistemas internos, assegurando a atualização e organização dos dados;

Qualificações:

  • Conhecimento em mecânica automotiva (diferencial);

Venha crescer com a AutoZone e impulsionar o futuro da sua carreira!

title: Especialista Senior de Activación de Marketing
description:
Objetivo de la posición:

Lidera la implementación y ejecución de los planes comerciales y de marketing integrados en múltiples países, asegurando su alineación con la estrategia regional y, al mismo tiempo, adaptando las iniciativas a las realidades de cada mercado local. Actúa como un vínculo estratégico entre los mercados locales y los equipos regionales, traduciendo la dirección regional en una ejecución local efectiva y elevando los insights de mercado para fortalecer la estrategia a nivel LATAM.

Define el “cómo” de la ejecución, dando forma al enfoque comercial, las mecánicas de activación y el modelo de implementación, asegurando consistencia, escalabilidad e impacto en todos los mercados.

Es responsable de ejecutar y dar seguimiento a todas las estrategias de marketing en cada país de la región.

Principales responsabilidades:

  • Liderar la implementación de planes comerciales integrados en los diferentes mercados, en estrecha colaboración con Marketing, Ventas, Finanzas, Cadena de Suministro y otros equipos multifuncionales.
  • Ser responsable de la excelencia en la ejecución a nivel LATAM, estableciendo estándares y mecanismos de gobernanza que aseguren el despliegue consistente, oportuno y de alta calidad de las iniciativas regionales, permitiendo al mismo tiempo una adaptación efectiva a las necesidades locales.
  • Liderar la traducción y optimización de las estrategias comerciales regionales en marcos de ejecución de alto impacto y relevancia local, asegurando la excelencia en la activación y resultados comerciales medibles en los diferentes mercados.
  • Liderar la integración de insights de los mercados locales y de información sobre desempeño en la estrategia LATAM, contribuyendo activamente a la toma de decisiones estratégicas e impulsando la mejora continua de la efectividad comercial en los mercados.
  • Impulsar una ejecución disciplinada, la gobernanza y el seguimiento del desempeño mediante un enfoque basado en datos, con el objetivo de mejorar la efectividad comercial y el compromiso de los ABOs.
  • Fungir como principal enlace entre los equipos de los mercados locales y los equipos regionales de Comercial y Marketing de LATAM.
  • Liderar el diseño y ejecución de planes personalizados de Local Growth Strategy (LGS) para líderes clave, incluyendo promociones, programas y eventos, en colaboración con los equipos locales de Ventas, para impulsar un crecimiento dirigido y un impacto medible en los principales KPIs comerciales.
  • Mantener una comunicación constante con los gerentes de Ventas para desarrollar e implementar los planes de LGS.
  • Participar activamente y fungir como portavoz durante giras comerciales, convenciones y otros eventos de ABOs, cuando sea necesario, como representante local de Marketing.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Ventas y Brand Managers para fortalecer el entendimiento de los planes comerciales, la excelencia en la activación y la calidad de ejecución en los diferentes mercados.
  • Ser responsable de la reducción del inventario excedente y obsoleto (E&O), traduciendo los insights de planeación en promociones e iniciativas de LGS dirigidas a mejorar la rotación de inventario y el desempeño de ventas, así como proporcionar retroalimentación continua a las posiciones responsables del pronóstico y la gestión del portafolio local mediante el monitoreo del inventario excedente y obsoleto
  • Impulsa la mejora continua mediante la identificación de brechas en la ejecución, mejores prácticas y oportunidades para mejorar el tiempo de implementación ( time-to-market ) y la efectividad del engagement.

Requisitos:

  • Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Marketing, Administración de Empresas, Comunicación o una carrera afín.
  • Experiencia:
  • 6 años de en operaciones de marketing, activación comercial, planeación integrada o roles de marketing regional.
  • Experiencia comprobada en la ejecución de planes comerciales integrados o estrategias de go-to-market , generando un impacto comercial medible.
  • Idioma: inglés intermedio y portugués avanzado

Conocimientos y habilidades:

Conocimientos:

  • Marcos de planeación comercial y de marketing integrados.
  • Estrategias de go-to-market y modelos de activación comercial.
  • Modelos de negocio basados en ABOs o distribuidores ( deseable ).
  • Métricas de desempeño de Marketing, KPIs y mecanismos de gobernanza de la ejecución.
  • Dinámica entre las estrategias regionales y las necesidades de los mercados locales en LATAM.
  • Visión y entendimiento del negocio ( Business Acumen ).

Habilidades:

  • Sólidas habilidades de ejecución y gestión de activaciones en múltiples mercados.

title: Social Media Lead
description:
About AIsa

AIsa is building the resource and payment network for AI agents .

As AI agents move from chatbots to long-running systems that perform real work, they increasingly need access to external resources — premium data, APIs, AI models, SaaS tools, compute, and other services — at runtime.

AIsa gives agents and developers one integration to discover, access, use, and pay for these resources programmatically.

Backed by Alibaba, Tribe Capital, Draper Associates, Sumitomo Corporation, and other leading investors , AIsa works with premium technology and data providers to make their services agent-ready.

We are building infrastructure for a world where software increasingly acts, purchases, and transacts on behalf of people and businesses.

We are looking for a Social Media Lead to help define how that story is told — and make AIsa one of the most recognizable voices in the emerging AI agent ecosystem.

The Role

The Social Media Lead will own AIsa’s social presence and help build the company into a category-defining brand around AI agents, agent infrastructure, paid data and tools, and agent-native commerce .

This is not a traditional corporate social media role.

You will work directly with the founders and closely with product, partnerships, developer relations, growth, and communications to turn what is happening inside AIsa — product launches, customer behavior, partnerships, industry observations, technical insights, and founder thinking — into content that people actually want to read, share, discuss, and remember.

You will be responsible for both:

  1. Turning existing ideas and company activity into great social content

and

  1. Creating social-native ideas, conversations, formats, and campaigns from scratch.

The role will initially focus heavily on X and LinkedIn , while expanding AIsa’s presence across Reddit, YouTube, short-form video, developer communities, and other channels where AI builders and operators spend their time.

You will also help develop the social presence of AIsa’s founders and senior team, creating a coordinated but authentic network of voices around the company.

What You’ll DoBuild AIsa’s social strategy

Own the strategy for how AIsa shows up across X, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube, and emerging platforms.

Define:

  • Who we want to reach
  • What conversations we want to own
  • What AIsa should be known for
  • Which content formats work for each audience
  • How company, founder, product, and community accounts work together

Translate this strategy into an operating system: editorial calendar, publishing cadence, content pipeline, campaigns, experiments, and measurement.

But this is not a role where success means keeping a calendar full.

The goal is to build attention, credibility, community, and category leadership .

Build a distinct AIsa voice

Help develop a social voice that is technical enough for builders, commercially sharp enough for founders and operators, and accessible enough for a broader technology audience.

AIsa should never sound like generic enterprise software marketing.

Our content should be able to move naturally between:

  • Sharp observations about AI agents
  • Technical product insights
  • Founder opinions
  • Industry commentary
  • Product demonstrations
  • Customer use cases
  • Data and charts
  • Memes and internet-native formats
  • Partnership announcements
  • Longer-form thought leadership

You should know when something deserves a serious technical explanation — and when the same idea would perform better as one sentence, one screenshot, or one meme.

Turn company activity into content

AIsa is operating in a fast-moving ecosystem with constant product, customer, and partnership activity.

You will identify the stories hidden inside the company and turn them into compelling content.

Examples might include:

  • A new premium data provider becoming available to AI agents
  • How an agent autonomously uses Similarweb or other external APIs
  • What millions of agent resource calls teach us about machine behavior
  • New patterns we observe in long-running agents
  • Product launches and integrations
  • Developer use cases
  • Customer stories
  • Founder insights
  • Industry events and conferences
  • Major ecosystem shifts in AI agents
  • Research and proprietary data from the AIsa network

You should constantly be asking:

“What is happening inside AIsa right now that the rest of the internet would find interesting?”

Create social-native content

Do not wait for someone to hand you a blog post.

Develop content specifically for social media, including:

  • Short posts
  • Threads
  • Charts
  • Screenshots
  • Product demos
  • Videos
  • Clips
  • Founder commentary
  • Interviews
  • Memes
  • Community questions
  • Data-driven posts
  • Recurring content formats
  • Launch campaigns
  • Event coverage

You should be comfortable creating content yourself and coordinating with designers, video editors, engineers, and other team members when production support is needed.

Own real-time industry participation

AI moves extremely fast.

You should be deeply plugged into conversations around:

  • AI agents
  • Agent infrastructure
  • Agentic workflows
  • MCP and tools
  • Data infrastructure
  • API platforms
  • Enterprise AI
  • Agent payments and commerce
  • Developer tools
  • AI startups

You should understand what people are talking about today , not what was important six months ago.

Identify important conversations early and determine when AIsa should:

  • Comment
  • Reply
  • Explain
  • Challenge
  • Amplify
  • Publish original analysis
  • Stay out of the conversation

Great social media is participation, not broadcasting.

Build relationships with the ecosystem

Develop relationships with the people shaping the AI agent ecosystem:

  • AI founders
  • Agent builders
  • Developers
  • Researchers
  • Investors
  • Developer advocates
  • Open-source maintainers
  • AI creators
  • Technology journalists
  • Industry analysts

Engage thoughtfully with their work and help make AIsa a respected participant in the community rather than simply another company account promoting itself.

Build founder-led media

Work closely with AIsa’s founders to translate their observations, opinions, conversations, and experiences into compelling social content.

This may include:

  • Founder posts
  • Industry commentary
  • Product insights
  • Long-form posts
  • Conference observations
  • Interviews
  • Podcasts
  • Contrarian theses
  • Company-building lessons

You should be able to listen to a 20-minute founder conversation and identify the two sentences that could become a great post.

The goal is not ghostwriting a manufactured personality.

It is helping authentic ideas travel further.

Launch products and partnerships

Work with product, partnerships, communications, and growth to build social campaigns around major launches.

A launch should rarely be one announcement post.

You should think about the full narrative:

Before launch → launch → explanation → demonstration → customer use case → ecosystem conversation → follow-up content.

You will help turn product launches into moments.

Measure, experiment, and improve

Treat social media as an iterative growth system.

Track more than follower counts.

Understand:

  • Reach
  • Engagement quality
  • Audience composition
  • Share rate
  • Content retention
  • Profile conversion
  • Website traffic
  • Developer signups
  • Product activation
  • Community growth
  • Which narratives consistently resonate

Develop hypotheses, run experiments, analyze results, and feed those learnings back into the content strategy.

You should be equally comfortable using data and editorial judgment.

What We’re Looking For

You are probably a strong fit if you:

  • Have owned social media or audience growth for a high-growth technology company, founder, media brand, or developer-focused product
  • Can show examples of content you personally created that generated meaningful reach, engagement, or community discussion
  • Are an exceptional writer with strong editorial judgment
  • Understand how writing for X is different from LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube, or a company blog
  • Have strong instincts for internet culture and know why some content spreads while other content feels corporate
  • Can explain complicated technology in simple, interesting language
  • Follow AI developments obsessively and have genuine curiosity about where agents are going
  • Are comfortable working directly with founders
  • Can move quickly without requiring layers of approvals
  • Are comfortable simultaneously being strategist, writer, editor, operator, and community participant
  • Have strong visual instincts, even if you are not a professional designer
  • Understand analytics and can use data to improve creative decisions
  • Can manage multiple launches, conversations, and content streams simultaneously
  • Have low ego and enjoy collaborating with technical and non-technical teams
Especially Valuable

You do not need to check every box, but we would be especially interested if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • AI developer tools
  • AI agents
  • Developer communities
  • API or data products
  • Enterprise software
  • Open-source projects
  • Technical content
  • Founder-led brands
  • Technology media
  • Product launches
  • Short-form video
  • Community-led growth
  • Reddit or developer forums
  • Running high-growth X accounts
  • Building an audience from an early stage
What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, success means AIsa has become one of the accounts people consistently encounter when they follow the evolution of AI agents.

People should increasingly associate AIsa with questions such as:

How do agents access external resources?

How do agents discover and choose APIs and data?

How should companies control what their agents can purchase and use?

How will autonomous agents transact with the internet?

What infrastructure does the agent economy require?

And when major developments happen in this space, AIsa should increasingly be part of the conversation.

We care about audience growth.

But more importantly, we care about building category recognition, credibility, and influence .

How We Work

AIsa is an early-stage company operating in one of the fastest-moving areas of technology.

That means:

  • We move fast
  • We ship frequently
  • We experiment
  • We debate ideas openly
  • We expect people to take ownership

We are looking for someone who wants to build the media engine of an emerging technology category , not simply manage another corporate social account.

title: Analista de Torre de Controle Logística PL (Custos)
description:
Sobre a vaga

Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4,6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases de desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Localidade: Inocência — Mato Grosso do Sul

Desafio:

Analisar e acompanhar os custos e indicadores de performance da Torre de Controle, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional por meio da consolidação de dados, avaliação de desvios orçamentários e suporte às análises da área — apoiando a tomada de decisão e a melhoria contínua dos resultados operacionais e financeiros.

Principais Atividades:

  • Consolidar e analisar dados operacionais e financeiros da Torre de Controle;
  • Acompanhar o orçamento da operação (realizado vs. orçado), identificando desvios e variações relevantes;
  • Apoiar a análise de causas de desvios de custo, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização de recursos;

  • Acompanhar contratos operacionais, apoiando controle de consumo, medições e aderência contratual;
  • Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e dashboards de acompanhamento de performance;
  • Consolidar, validar e garantir a confiabilidade das bases de dados operacionais e financeiras;
  • Apoiar processos de orçamento, forecast e revisões de planejamento financeiro;
  • Contribuir para a padronização dos processos de controle de custos;
  • Participar de iniciativas de melhoria contínua relacionadas à eficiência operacional e financeira.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;

  • Experiência com construção e análise de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs);

  • Outros programas relevantes de inovação e deep tech.

Experiência comprovada em projetos aprovados será um diferencial muito forte.

Não basta dizer:

“Tenho experiência com grants.”

Queremos saber:

  • Qual programa?
  • Qual empresa?
  • Qual valor?
  • Qual ano?
  • Qual foi sua participação?
  • Você escreveu a proposta?
  • Você conduziu a submissão?
  • O projeto foi aprovado?
DIFERENCIAIS IMPORTANTES

Experiência em:

  • AI / Machine Learning;
  • Deep Tech;
  • Cybersecurity;
  • Enterprise Software;
  • AI Governance;
  • RegTech;
  • Infrastructure;
  • Autonomous Systems;
  • SaaS B2B;
  • Technology commercialisation;
  • Venture capital;
  • Fundraising;
  • Investor Relations.

Conhecimento de TRL, P&D, inovação tecnológica e comercialização de tecnologia será altamente valorizado.

PERFIL COMPORTAMENTAL

Procuramos alguém:

  • Extremamente organizado;
  • Analítico;
  • Excelente escritor;
  • Excelente comunicador;
  • Autônomo;
  • Comercialmente orientado;
  • Curioso;
  • Resiliente;
  • Obsessivo com detalhes;
  • Capaz de trabalhar com prazos;
  • Confortável conversando com técnicos e executivos;
  • Capaz de entender tecnologia complexa rapidamente;
  • Orientado a resultados.
Principalmente:

Hands-on.

Não queremos alguém que apenas diga à equipe o que fazer.

Queremos alguém que faça.

O QUE SERÁ CONSIDERADO UM DIFERENCIAL ENORME

Ter participado de uma aplicação que recebeu:

  • £500k+;
  • €1M+;
  • R$1M+;

em funding de inovação, e conseguir demonstrar exatamente qual foi sua contribuição .

Também será um diferencial ter experiência em apresentar projetos para:

  • investidores;
  • VCs;
  • corporate venture;
  • fundos de deep tech;
  • órgãos públicos;
  • parceiros estratégicos.
COMO MEDIREMOS O SUCESSO

Nos primeiros meses, esperamos construir um pipeline estruturado contendo:

Funding Opportunities → Qualification → Applications → Submitted → Under Review → Approved

E posteriormente:

Investors → Contacted → Qualified → Meetings → Due Diligence → Investment

O desempenho será avaliado principalmente por:

  • Qualidade das oportunidades identificadas;
  • Número de aplicações qualificadas;
  • Qualidade das propostas;
  • Taxa de aprovação;
  • Valor de funding obtido;
  • Qualidade do pipeline;
  • Número de investidores estratégicos identificados;
  • Reuniões qualificadas geradas;
  • Qualidade do relacionamento com investidores.
MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO

PJ / Contractor / Fractional

Trabalho remoto.

Preferência por profissionais localizados no Brasil, com disponibilidade para trabalhar também com oportunidades internacionais e fusos horários UK/EU.

Possibilidade de evolução para uma posição permanente de liderança da área de Funding & Investor Relations , dependendo de performance.

REMUNERAÇÃO

A remuneração será definida de acordo com experiência e histórico comprovado.

Estamos abertos a modelos envolvendo:

Remuneração fixa + variável por performance.

Para profissionais excepcionais, podemos estruturar um modelo de remuneração compatível com a senioridade e responsabilidade da função.

COMO SE CANDIDATAR

Envie:

1. CV ou LinkedIn

2. Lista de grants/projetos que você ajudou a aprovar

Para cada projeto, informe:

  • Programa;
  • País;
  • Valor aprovado;
  • Ano;
  • Empresa;
  • Sua função;
  • Se você escreveu a proposta;
  • Se participou da submissão;
  • Resultado.

3. Breve descrição da sua experiência com tecnologia/deep tech

4. Experiência com investidores/fundraising, se houver

5. Modelo de remuneração esperado

6. Disponibilidade semanal

PROCESSO SELETIVO

O processo poderá incluir um case prático .

O candidato receberá uma descrição resumida da MARTIN™ e deverá:

  1. Identificar oportunidades de funding relevantes;
  2. Justificar por que cada oportunidade possui fit;
  3. Priorizar as oportunidades;
  4. Propor uma estratégia de aplicação;
  5. Estruturar uma narrativa inicial para um grant;
  6. Identificar potenciais investidores estratégicos;
  7. Explicar como abordaria esses investidores.

Queremos avaliar principalmente sua capacidade de pensar, estruturar e executar .

Se você é o tipo de profissional que olha para uma tecnologia complexa e pensa:

“Onde conseguimos financiamento para desenvolver isso?”

e depois:

“Como transformamos esse projeto em uma proposta vencedora?”

e finalmente:

“Quem deveria investir nessa empresa?”

queremos conversar com você.

MARTIN™

AI Governance. Verified Execution. Trusted Autonomy.

title: COORDENADOR(A) FISCAL - FATURAMENTO
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.

Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.

O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
Sales Operations Analyst - Latin America

Position Summary

Access Information Management is hiring a Sales Operations Analyst to provide dedicated operational support for our Latin America sales organization, including Brazil, Chile, Panama, Costa Rica, and Trinidad & Tobago. This role will partner closely with regional sales leaders and sellers to improve pipeline visibility, forecast accuracy, CRM discipline, and execution against revenue priorities.

This is a hands-on sales operations role centered on the core operating cadence of the business. Day-to-day work includes pipeline and forecast support, performance reporting, territory and quota administration, data quality, process governance, and cross-functional coordination. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capability with the communication skills and regional context needed to support teams across multiple countries and languages.

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Administration and Data Quality

  • Maintain accurate CRM data across accounts, opportunities, contacts, territories, and account hierarchies
  • Monitor and remediate data quality issues, including duplicates, missing fields, ownership gaps, and hierarchy misalignments
  • Support routine Salesforce administration, including reporting, dashboards, fields, validation rules, user access, and data updates
  • Drive consistent CRM usage and sales process adherence across the Latin America sales organization

Pipeline, Forecasting, and Performance Reporting

  • Build and maintain pipeline, forecast, bookings, and seller performance reports in Salesforce and connected BI tools
  • Support weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecast cycles through data preparation, pipeline inspection, variance analysis, and follow-up
  • Identify pipeline risks, gaps, stalled opportunities, and data inconsistencies; provide clear findings and recommended actions to sales leaders
  • Prepare recurring business reviews and performance reporting for regional sales leadership, Revenue Operations, and Finance

Sales Planning and Execution Support

  • Support territory design, account assignment, quota allocation, and coverage planning across Brazil, Chile, Panama, Costa Rica, and Trinidad & Tobago
  • Maintain sales planning files, account and territory mappings, target allocations, and related documentation
  • Provide operational support for lead routing, opportunity management, account ownership, and sales stage governance
  • Track execution against sales priorities and coordinate follow-up actions with regional leaders and sellers

Commercial Operations and Process Management

  • Document and maintain sales processes, operating procedures, data definitions, and reporting logic
  • Identify practical process improvements that reduce manual work, improve data reliability, and simplify seller execution
  • Support adoption of approved tools and process changes through documentation, training materials, and user guidance

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Latin America Sales, Finance, Marketing, Client Success, and global Revenue Operations on planning and execution priorities
  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for questions involving CRM data, pipeline metrics, forecast reporting, territories, and sales process
  • Coordinate regional requirements with global teams while maintaining consistent definitions, controls, and reporting standards

Qualifications Required

  • Professional fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese, with the ability to support business discussions and written communication in all three languages
  • Experience in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial operations, or a closely related analytical role
  • Salesforce proficiency, including reports, dashboards, opportunity management, object relationships, and data administration
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets capability, including data analysis, reconciliation, and structured modeling
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales data, identify issues, and present clear findings and actions
  • Experience supporting pipeline management, forecasting, sales performance reporting, or recurring business reviews
  • High attention to detail, strong follow-through, and the ability to manage priorities across multiple countries and stakeholders

title: Data Test Engineer
description:
Data Test Engineer

Location: Remote in Brazil

Duration: Long-term contract

Data Test Engineering

DTE validates analytics and data pipelines end-to-end, from events generated across streaming clients through ingestion, transformation, data warehouses, and downstream reporting

  • We are looking for a hands-on Data Test Engineer who combines data validation automation engineering and strong troubleshooting skills to protect data quality at streaming scale

What You'll Do

  • Validate analytics events across Web, iOS, Android TV, TV, tvOS, Roku, Fire TV, and other connected TV platforms
  • Validate data end-to-end across ingestion, transformation, and reporting layers using SQL and data profiling to verify transformations, identify anomalies, and troubleshoot data quality issues, including validation in BigQuery
  • Build and maintain Java Spring-based automation for scalable backend and pipeline validation
  • Expand automated regression coverage within DTE and shared GQE automation frameworks
  • Create and use Claude Skills and AI-assisted tools such as Claude and Cursor to improve validation test development, troubleshooting, and engineering productivity
  • Develop test strategies and partner with BI Data Architecture AIDE, Product, and Engineering to drive issues through resolution
  • Support production validation platform rollouts, traffic ramps, and post-launch data monitoring

Qualifications

  • 5 years of QA Test Engineering, Data Quality Engineering, or related experience, with 3 years focused on data pipelines, warehousing, or analytics validation
  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with BigQuery or similar cloud data warehouses
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end data pipelines from event generation and ingestion through transformation and reporting
  • Java development experience, preferably with Spring Boot for automation frameworks or backend validation
  • Experience building or contributing to automated test data validation frameworks
  • Experience validating analytics implementations across web, mobile, OTT, or connected TV platforms
  • Experience with Python or shell scripting and cloud data platforms such as GCP, AWS, Airflow, Cloud Composer, and MongoDB Atlas; exposure to Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Tableau, Mode, Tealium, or Redshift is a plus
  • Experience with AI-assisted development or testing using tools such as Claude, Cursor, Claude Skills AI agents, or other LLM-based workflows is a plus
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills in an Agile engineering environment

title: Paid Social Media Buyer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As a Paid Social Media Buyer at Lilo Social, you will own the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid social campaigns for a portfolio of DTC eCommerce clients. You will work closely with our creative team to test new concepts, analyze performance data to identify scaling opportunities, and maintain client relationships through strategic communication and data-driven recommendations. Your ability to balance multiple accounts while maintaining exceptional ROAS performance will directly impact client growth and satisfaction.

What success looks like:

  • Consistent month-over-month ROAS improvement across your client portfolio through strategic testing and optimization
  • High client satisfaction and retention driven by proactive communication, strategic insights, and measurable revenue growth
  • Efficient creative testing roadmaps that quickly identify winning concepts and scale budgets profitably
  • Strong collaboration with creative strategists, designers, and project managers to maintain velocity and quality across all accounts

Responsibilities

  • Strategize, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns across Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok platforms for multiple client accounts
  • Manage daily campaign budgets, bid strategies, and pacing to meet client revenue and ROAS targets
  • Conduct frequent A/B testing across audiences, placements, creative formats, and messaging to identify scalable opportunities
  • Analyze campaign performance data to provide actionable insights and strategic recommendations for optimization
  • Collaborate with creative strategists and designers to provide performance feedback on ad creative and develop testing hypotheses
  • Build and refine audience segments using Meta's targeting capabilities, including custom audiences, lookalikes, and interest-based targeting
  • Monitor and troubleshoot pixel implementation, conversion tracking, and attribution to ensure accurate performance measurement
  • Prepare and present weekly or bi-weekly performance reports to clients, highlighting wins, learnings, and strategic next steps
  • Maintain constant communication with internal teams and clients to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and campaign objectives
  • Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns while maintaining efficiency metrics
  • Stay current on platform updates, new features, and industry best practices across Meta, TikTok, and emerging social platforms
  • Implement and maintain quality assurance processes to ensure error-free campaign launches and ad copy accuracy

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on paid social media buying experience, with a proven track record managing Meta Ads Manager (Facebook and Instagram advertising)
  • Demonstrated experience managing monthly ad budgets of $50,000 or more for direct-to-consumer or eCommerce brands
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable optimization strategies
  • Expert knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Business Manager, and conversion tracking (Meta Pixel, events, custom conversions)
  • Experience developing and executing creative testing methodologies, including structured A/B testing frameworks
  • Proven ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously in an agency environment with competing priorities and tight deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting campaign performance and strategic recommendations to clients
  • Self-motivated and detail-oriented, with exceptional organizational skills and the ability to maintain quality while working at high velocity

Nice to Have

  • Experience with TikTok Ads Manager, Snapchat Ads, or Pinterest Ads platforms
  • Familiarity with attribution and analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, or Rockerbox
  • Meta Blueprint certification or other relevant platform certifications
  • Experience with Google Ads or other paid media channels to support integrated campaign strategies
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page best practices
  • Knowledge of email marketing platforms like Klaviyo or experience working with retention marketing strategies

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on US hours
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Principal QA Automation Engineer Playwright
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Principal QA Automation Engineer Playwright** with deep, hands-on expertise in **Playwright** to build and maintain automated testing solutions for web applications and APIs.

**Location:** Remote

**Work Hours:** Must be available during EST/EDT business hours

**Employment Type:** Contract

### Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain a scalable Playwright automation framework using TypeScript or JavaScript.

* Create automated functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and API tests.

* Develop reusable fixtures, page objects, utilities, and test-data solutions.

* Use Playwright locators, auto-waiting, assertions, projects, and test configuration to create reliable tests.

* Execute parallel and cross-browser testing across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

* Perform API testing using Playwright’s `APIRequestContext`.

* Implement network mocking, request interception, authentication-state reuse, and test-data setup.

* Configure Playwright tracing, screenshots, videos, retries, and HTML reporting for troubleshooting.

* Reduce flaky tests and improve automation stability, execution speed, and test coverage.

* Integrate Playwright tests with CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.

* Collaborate with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams throughout the development lifecycle.

### Required Qualifications

* 10+ years of QA automation experience.

* At least 5 years of recent, production-level Playwright experience.

* Strong TypeScript or JavaScript programming skills.

* Experience building or significantly enhancing a Playwright framework from scratch.

* Strong knowledge of Playwright Test Runner, fixtures, hooks, projects, parallelization, and worker management.

* Experience with resilient locators, role-based selectors, auto-waiting, and debugging.

* Hands-on experience with Playwright API testing, route handling, network mocking, and authentication.

* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

* Strong understanding of web technologies, REST APIs, SQL, Git, and Agile practices.

* Ability to work remotely during EST/EDT hours.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Docker, BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or LambdaTest.

* Familiarity with Playwright visual comparisons, accessibility testing, and mobile-device emulation.

* Experience with Allure, Playwright HTML reports, or ReportPortal.

* Exposure to performance, security, or contract testing.

* Experience in insurance, banking, financial services, or healthcare is a plus.

title: Customer Experience Specialist
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: CPO/Product Manager

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

We recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We’re looking for a Customer Experience Specialist to own how Nova shows up for its customers, from the first support message to the public review that comes after it.

This role goes beyond basic ticket handling. Our first line of support is an AI agent, and a big part of your role is making it better every week: finding where it fails, feeding it the right answers, and stepping in yourself when a human is genuinely needed.

You'll own everything around it — our reputation on the App Store, Google Play and ReclameAqui, proactive outreach when a customer’s situation calls for it, and bringing what you hear back to Product and Marketing so we fix the root cause.

You’ll be the voice of the customer inside a small, fast-moving fintech team, with real ownership from day one.

This role is perfect for someone who:

  • Is genuinely obsessed with customer satisfaction
  • Uses AI to work better and faster, not just because it’s trendy
  • Wants to build a support operation, not just staff one

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop our AI support agent: continuously improve the AI agent that handles our first line of support — reviewing conversations, identifying gaps and failure cases, refining answers and knowledge base content, and raising the share of cases resolved without human help;
  • Handle escalations: personally respond to the cases where a human is required, with care, accuracy and speed;
  • Own our public reputation: monitor and respond across App Store, Google Play and ReclameAqui, and be accountable for our scores and response times on those channels;
  • Proactive outreach: reach out directly to customers in specific situations — failed payments, incidents, high-value or at-risk users — before they have to come to us;
  • Lead the Monthly Customer Support Meeting: prepare the data, surface the main pain points and trends, and drive follow-ups to completion;
  • Work side-by-side with Product Managers and Marketing: turn support signal into product fixes and clearer communication, and make sure customer-facing messaging matches what customers actually experience;
  • Keep things organized: support macros, help center content, processes and metrics — documented and up to date.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • Obsessed with customer satisfaction — you take it personally when someone has a bad experience;
  • Excellent Portuguese writing & communication skills — clear, warm and firm in the same message;
  • Great verbal communication — comfortable on the phone, on a call, and in front of the team. You'll be leading initiatives and reporting;
  • Comfortable with English (intermediate is enough — we work internally in English);
  • AI Native and Enthusiast: you already use AI tools to make your own work better and more efficient (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), and you’re excited about shaping an AI agent rather than competing with it;
  • Organized and autonomous — you can own a process end to end without being chased;
  • Strong team player, curious and proactive.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience in customer support, customer success or customer experience — ideally in fintech, banking or a high-volume consumer app;
  • Familiarity with support tooling (Intercom, Zendesk or similar) and reputation channels (ReclameAqui, app store reviews);
  • Comfort with data: able to pull, read and present support metrics (volume, CSAT, first response time, resolution rate);
  • Experience dealing with sensitive topics — payments, charges, fraud, disputes;
  • Fast learner who thrives in dynamic, ambitious environments.

How You Work

  • Collaborative: open, communicative, team-oriented
  • Customer-obsessed: you listen closely and follow through
  • AI Native: you automate the repetitive so you can focus on what matters
  • Ambitious: eager to grow quickly and deliver impact
  • Owner mindset: you fix the root cause, not just the ticket

Other Requirements

  • Location: 3x per week (Tue, Wed, Thu) at our office in São Paulo
  • English mandatory

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.
